image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown in a natural, moist environment. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes. It is positioned on wet ground with moss, leaves, and small rocks visible around it. The salamander's body is elongated and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The head is broad and flattened, and the tail extends behind the body.
